posts.title: My moderation times-explanation.
posts.edited: Last edited by Callum; 23-12-2009 at 02:12 AM .
posts.html:
I once was a moderator for VM as some of you may know, greatest times of my life which you may consider sad, but it gave me something to do and I was happy to be able to help people.

Before I got the status, I arranged a meeting with the mayor and was being escorted by a police officer, before I got on the elevator I was KO'd by another cop, the cop escorting me explained to him yet he kept spamming the KO onto me. I asked him to stop and he did not, so I said something like this; "[LOOC]: When I get my moderator status this afternoon I'll ban you for this.".

I got my moderator status and did not ban him, I figured I over reacted.
During the two days I had my status me and Chronic helped each other out by taking turns to administrate so we could still Roleplay, I had in total banned two people; I do not remember the names, only the reasons: The first guy was banned for RDM, which I clearly found in the logs. The second guy had disconnected to avoid a hostage situation so I banned him for 2 hours, I had warned him and he did it anyway.

Anyway, I also got teleported by Clown. Him and other admins had a bug and they could not see who owned this contra, the contraband was placed on the Broadcast station near the pool and this I guess was so it couldn't be destroyed.

I'd like to say that I enjoyed it while it lasted and my only regret was the cause of revoke. I thank Clown for giving me the chance I've dreamed of.

Drewley revoked my status as I wasn't on the server, and I felt broken inside when I found out.

But I hope that all the people I helped appreciated it and won't forget.

I'm sorry for the fuck-up, Clown.
